args.purpose: Count distinct orders placed by customers whose city is 'sao paulo' (lowercase, no accents)
args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(c.customer_city) = 'são paulo' OR c.customer_city = 'sao paulo'
